arguments.code:
import os
from pathlib import Path

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Resolve auth tokens
try:
    spotify_access_token = spotify_token
except NameError:
    spotify_access_token = apis.spotify.login(
        username='ka_burt@gmail.com',
        password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
    )['access_token']

try:
    file_access_token = fs_res['access_token']
except NameError:
    file_access_token = apis.file_system.login(
        username='ka_burt@gmail.com',
        password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
    )['access_token']

# Build union_song_ids if missing
try:
    union_song_ids
except NameError:
    # song library
    song_library_song_ids = set()
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for s in page:
            song_library_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
        page_index += 1

    # album library
    album_songs = set()
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for a in page:
            for sid in (a.get('song_ids') or []):
                album_songs.add(sid)
        page_index += 1

    # playlist library
    playlist_songs = set()
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for p in page:
            for sid in (p.get('song_ids') or []):
                playlist_songs.add(sid)
        page_index += 1

    union_song_ids = song_library_song_ids | album_songs | playlist_songs

union_song_ids = set(union_song_ids)
print('UNIQUE song_id count:', len(union_song_ids))

# Ensure directory exists
apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path='~/backups', access_token=file_access_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

# Create CSV content
rows = []
rows.append('Title,Artists')

for sid in sorted(union_song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = song.get('title') or ''
    artists = song.get('artists') or []
    artist_names = [a.get('name') or '' for a in artists]
    artist_field = '|'.join(artist_names)
    rows.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artist_field)}")

content = '\n'.join(rows) + '\n'
print('CSV size (chars):', len(content))

file_path='~/backups/spotify.csv'
# Write file (overwrite if exists)
res_file = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=file_access_token, content=content, overwrite=True)
print('file write:', res_file)

# Terminate Spotify account after backup
res_delete = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('delete_account:', res_delete)

# Complete task
res_complete = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print('complete_task:', res_complete)
